A small fix for the web map. Since the smooth zooming in 1.4.0-beta.1, the map's tiles could be drawn over its controls, so the top bar, the coordinates and the player markers sometimes disappeared under the map. They now always show on top. Nothing else has changed since 1.4.0-beta.1.

Testing: open a server's map, pan and zoom around, and check the top bar, the zoom buttons, the coordinates, the player list and the player markers stay visible. The rest of the testing notes are in [testing-1.4.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.4.0-beta.2/docs/testing/testing-1.4.0.md).
